item.description:
What's new in 1.45.18

  • Fixed a freeze when scrolling the catalog (for example while building a change order): item prices are now computed in the background, so a large catalog or a heavy pricing formula no longer stalls the app.

What's new in 1.45.17

  • Expired items: sending a proposal to sign (or a change order for payment) that uses catalog items changed since the proposal was created is now held for admin review in a new "Expired Items" tab — with a side-by-side diff of the proposal's saved item vs. the current catalog item — to approve (keeping the saved prices) or decline.
  • Proposals and change orders now keep a frozen copy of each catalog item, so editing a catalog item later no longer changes existing proposals or their contracts.
  • Document generation lets you pick which template to use per document type before sending.

Version 1.45.16

Changed

  • Submit Sale: the salutation is prefilled from the primary (and secondary) contact — e.g. “Mr. and Mrs. Smith” when they share a last name — with hyphen-aware capitalization.
  • “Dr.” added to the title options (Mr. / Ms. / Mrs. / Dr.).

Version 1.45.15

Added

  • Sales users see a commission preview on the proposal/change-order summary page, auto-filled from the live deal.
  • Submit Sale collects basement photos on step 2 and uploads them in the background; the stepper dots are clickable to jump between steps.

Changed

  • Submit Sale contact confirmation rebuilt: confirm the primary contact, optionally add a secondary contact, then confirm one salutation for all automated emails (with required-field validation).
  • Commission is paid on the Final/Contract Total and driven by the setup discount you entered; the preview takes the final total as input and rates show two decimals.
  • Contract and deposit status is written only by the backend, so the app no longer stamps it locally.
  • A catalog item used only in proposals/change orders can now be deleted; only inherited child items still block deletion.

Fixed

  • Catalog numbers no longer glitch after reordering or duplicating an item.
  • “Edit incentives” now lists only the value tiers added to the current pricing zone.

What's new in 1.45.14

  • Value tiers can overlap freely in the library, but the tiers enabled for a service's pricing zone can no longer intersect — Save is blocked and the conflict is named.
  • Item reordering on a category page is now saved (it previously reverted on reopen).
  • Change-order list positions no longer reshuffle after document actions.
  • Per-service pricing-zone settings: the "unsaved changes" indicator now appears only for real edits and clears after saving; added a "Decline changes" button.
  • Client id is included in the proposal and change-order payloads.

What's new in 1.45.13

  • Value tiers and incentives are configured per pricing zone on each service, so discount caps apply per geographic zone again.
  • Combined incentive cap now has a global default, overridable per service. Creating a proposal outside the cap shows a dialog naming the active cap, and a proposal below the minimum needs an approved exception.
  • Submit Sale no longer shows an error when the submit actually succeeds.
  • Fixed subcategory reordering that could loop or hang on a spinner.
  • Incentive cards shake when dragged past their own limit; per-service/zone settings can't be saved when the incentive ranges don't fit the cap.

What's new in 1.45.12

  • Fixed a crash that quit the app when saving a proposal or change order.

What's new in 1.45.11

  • Fixed: fractional item quantities (e.g. 2.5) are sent correctly instead of being rounded down.
  • Fixed: the Square footage settings field accepts decimals.
  • Commission Preview shows a live Final Total that drops as the incentive rises.
  • Generate Docs is disabled once documents exist, with a clearer "being generated" message.
  • Clearer outgoing-arrow "sent" icon; Submit Sale copy/form tweaks; Pricing Zones required-field marker.

What's new in 1.45.9

  • Fixed: Price-Not-Applicable items can now be removed from an estimate after being added.
  • The generated-documents list now rides on every proposal, change-order, and submit-sale payload.
  • Close button on the Submit Sale form; the yes/no buttons are now fully tappable.

What's new in 1.45.8

  • Submit Sale sends the consultant email, sale price/date, and commission (rate + amount) with the sale; commission rules and amount now ride on every proposal and change-order payload.
  • Commission is paid on the final, post-incentive total; the Commission Preview tool uses the Final Total and limits the incentive slider to the employee's range.
  • Wider "Input" column in the item tables.
  • "Send to client to sign" now requires the deposit to be sent or paid first.
  • Fixed: Price-Not-Applicable items can be added to an estimate again.
  • Fixed: freshly generated documents show immediately instead of the old PDF.
  • Fixed: combined-cap incentive minimum is enforced when the value tier changes.

What's new in 1.45.7

  • New "Submit Sale" form to hand a signed project to production.
  • Client list tabs: All / In Progress / Past.
  • Proposal sections no longer reshuffle after doc actions.
  • Uploaded files keep their original filename; various fixes.

What's new in 1.45.6

  • Minor payload adjustment for the contract sign form.

What's new in 1.45.5

  • Fixes a false error shown after successfully sending/voiding a deposit or voiding a contract.

What's new in 1.45.4

  • Fixes proposal status not being sent to document generation.

What's new in 1.45.3

  • Fixes proposal document generation (the payload now includes line items).

What's new in 1.45.1

  • Client deposits — send / void deposits and track open ones (sent/paid) in a new Deposits tab.
  • Contract lifecycle — normal / sent / signed states, void a sent contract, and a clear "Contract Signed" indicator.
  • Document tools — a per-document preview column (CL/INT/SUB/CON), a Generate Docs action, and document codes.
  • Pre-sign form — confirm contact, secondary contact, start date, and send/draft before sending a contract.
  • Incentives — value tiers, pricing-zone rules, exception requests, and expired-date protection.
  • Saved custom items, plus many QA fixes.

What's new in 1.44

  • Commission rules — per-user setup, with an earnings preview for reps.
  • Resizable & hideable columns on the clients list.
  • Quick Estimate — start a proposal without a client.
  • Materials tab for custom items.
  • Owner initials line on item PDFs.
  • Smarter required logic — nested conditions and per-item unit type.
  • Reworked refund screen, more accurate PDF totals, iPad list polish, more reliable sign-in.
